author: Nio (Master)

allowed_free_services: SaaS Free Tier or no-cost personal-account features
Google Gemini Gems and Gems from Google Labs when available at no cost
Google Drive, Docs, Sheets and NotebookLM no-cost features
forbidden_required_dependencies: Vertex AI or Google Cloud resources that require billing activation
any workflow whose essential path stops when a trial expires

secret_storage.n8n_policy: Load or sync at runtime without storing the key in tracked workflow JSON.

cost_policy.google_free_tier_data_notice: Public-domain book samples only; do not send private annotations to Free Tier APIs.

gemini_authentication.preferred: Google AI Studio authorization key dedicated to this project
gemini_authentication.current: Dedicated Gemini authorization key supplied by Nio, stored in the project-specific Git-ignored env file, and verified against the Models and gemini-embedding-2 embedContent endpoints on 2026-08-11.
gemini_authentication.migration_gate: Load GEMINI_API_KEY from the project-specific env for local and n8n runs. Do not use Vertex AI billing or OAuth unless requirements change.

canonical_data.rule: Book text, page images, citations, name decisions, provider-neutral JSONL chunks and approval state remain local and versioned. Embedding indexes are disposable derivatives.

routes.secondary: official vendor documentation on the web
routes.reason: Resolve current SDK and API contracts before implementation; use official product help for UI-only capabilities such as Gemini Gems and Opal.

routes.fallback: local OCR only when embedded text is unusable

routes.primary: Chandra OCR 2 on local PyTorch MPS after the Qwen structure batch releases unified memory
routes.current_fallback: Apple Vision accurate de-DE and en-US remains active until Chandra passes the Köhler p509 golden gate
routes.qualification_rule: Require Oenanthe Phellandrium, non-empty layout chunks and deterministic character-quality gain on volume 2 PDF page 509 before queue takeover.
routes.license_gate: Modified OpenRAIL-M weights are allowed only within the upstream personal/research or qualifying-startup scope; not unrestricted commercial deployment.
routes.reason: Chandra OCR 2 is the user-selected OCR family and is strong on German, old scans and multi-column layout, but it remains maker-only and cannot overwrite canonical text.

routes.primary: Qwen 3.5 27B 4-bit MLX local with deterministic line-anchor extraction
routes.fallback_maker: Qwen 3.5 9B 6-bit MLX for low-risk speed runs; Qwen 3.5 35B-A3B 6-bit retained only as rollback
routes.reviewer: Deterministic validator and Gemini page-image adjudication for layout-damaged OCR
routes.reason: The 27B qualification passed source-exact line-anchor extraction and Taiwan-name refusal. No local model may self-approve layout-sensitive OCR or image claims.

routes.fallback: Other Taiwan government or academic source, then authoritative Traditional Chinese or human-reviewed Traditional translation; Simplified Chinese is last
routes.reason: Names are metadata only and may not add facts absent from the book.

routes.primary: exact scientific-name aliases plus local BM25
routes.reason: Protects exact taxa, historical spellings and chemical terms.

routes.fallback: text-only local lexical index; mark image_semantic_search unavailable
routes.storage: rebuildable local SQLite vector store keyed by vector_space_id
routes.prompt_contract: Documents use title: ... | text: ...; QA queries use task: question answering | query: ...; do not send taskType to gemini-embedding-2.
routes.reason: Maps German text, Chinese queries and plates into one retrieval space without making that model space canonical.

routes.primary: Policy-first local API deterministic extraction from approved evidence
routes.secondary: Qwen local only after an answerable API response; Gemini Flash Free Tier only for approved multimodal evidence
routes.rule: Run scope, language, Taiwan-name and medical-advice gates before any generation. A generator may rewrite only returned answer_sentences and must preserve citations; it may not add plant facts.

reviewers: Google Gemini Notebook or NotebookLM source-grounded cross-check
GPT/Codex sampled adjudication in the current subscribed app, never paid API

routes.portability: Workflow JSON uses PLANT_ENCYCLOPEDIA_LAB and PLANT_ENCYCLOPEDIA_SECRETS_ENV instead of embedded machine paths.
routes.reason: Batching, checkpoints, retries, scheduling and run history.

routes.primary: Classic Gemini Gem linked to an approved evidence pack in Google Drive
routes.experimental: Gems from Google Labs powered by Opal, connected through the same retrieval JSON contract only after the account exposes a suitable external HTTP step
routes.fallback: local chat client against the same retrieval contract
routes.reason: Drive knowledge files are the currently documented stable bridge; no unverified direct Classic Gem webhook capability is assumed.

routes.public_exposure: forbidden until authentication, HTTPS and Nio approval are separately recorded
routes.reason: The local contract is free, dependency-light and portable; n8n, a future UI and an externally reachable Opal adapter can share the same response schema.

promotion_gates: Every factual answer sentence cites a source_id and PDF page.
Displayed Chinese name has a recorded authority and status.
Book facts and external name metadata remain separated.
Plate claims cite a plate page and pass multimodal review.
Unanswerable regression questions return 本書未記載 only after the relevant source scope is fully processed; otherwise return 尚未處理 or 現有已核准證據未找到.
